decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family close to the firm's core capabilities, supported by in-house R&D and having survived the initial post-launch period, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity and is likely to remain in the portfolio.

This door handle design is also close to the established offer and thus learnable and improvable within the firm's existing knowledge base, though as a narrower design product it faces somewhat more portfolio-refresh risk than a broader family.

The electronic access system is near the firm's existing system solutions, aligns with its strategic move toward digital building organization, and was presented as a flagship, so the firm is very likely to keep investing in it rather than withdraw it.
